episode.title: Entangled in Time
episode.style: soft pastel storybook, kid-friendly sci-fi, round shapes, big expressive eyes

characters.name: Elara
characters.visual: Young explorer with braided hair, star-patterned jacket, big expressive eyes, soft pastel colors

characters.name: Ziva
characters.visual: Sleek silver robot, friendly face, rounded edges, soft glowing lights

characters.name: Teddybot
characters.visual: Cute teddy bear robot, plush texture, button eyes, gentle smile

characters.name: Pranza
characters.visual: Small glowing alien, fluffy antenna, pastel colors, curious expression

characters.name: Lunaria
characters.visual: Round, friendly spaceship, pastel rainbow lights, large window cockpit

scenes.title: The Shimmering Portal
scenes.voiceover: High above the stars, Elara and her friends soared through space in the Lunaria. But today... something extraordinary appeared. A shimmering portal, glowing with rainbow light! Without hesitation, they flew inside.
shots: Wide starry space, Lunaria flying forward
Lunaria cockpit, Elara and friends looking amazed

scenes.title: Lost in the Time Vortex
scenes.voiceover: In an instant, they found themselves lost in a swirling time vortex. Rainbow spirals danced around them as ancient landscapes flashed by.
shots: Team floating inside swirling rainbow vortex

scenes.title: Exploring the Ancient World
scenes.voiceover: They landed in a world from long, long ago... filled with ancient jungles and forgotten secrets.
shots: Ancient jungle with oversized friendly plants
Giant gentle creatures in the distance

scenes.title: The Hieroglyphic Riddle
scenes.voiceover: In a mysterious ruin, they discovered a glowing riddle. It spoke of a sacred temple atop a distant mountain... and the Key hidden within.
shots: Inside ancient ruin, stone walls covered in glowing hieroglyphics

scenes.title: Journey to the Mountain Temple
scenes.voiceover: The journey was tough. Together, they climbed cliffs, crossed rope bridges, and outsmarted creatures guarding the temple.
shots: Temple entrance revealed in the clouds

scenes.title: Inside the Temple
scenes.voiceover: At last, they reached the ancient temple. Inside, futuristic technology glowed alongside mysterious ancient symbols.
shots: Advanced tech embedded in stone walls
Central pedestal with glowing Key of Quantum Entanglement

scenes.title: The Quantum Entanglement Burst
scenes.voiceover: When Elara touched the Key, a burst of rainbow energy engulfed them. In a flash, they were back in their own time — wiser, braver, and ready for more.
shots: Back in Lunaria, holding the glowing Key

scenes.title: Adventure Continues
scenes.voiceover: The universe is full of mysteries... and Elara’s team is just getting started. Their adventures continue.
